children: SAID ON THURSDAY IT POSTPONES PUBLICATION OF ITS RESULTS FOR H1 2026, WHICH WILL TAKE PLACE NO LATER THAN OCTOBER 10, 2026
DELAY IS DUE TO THE NEED TO REASSESS THE ACCOUNTING TREATMENT OF SOME HIGHLY TECHNICALLY COMPLEX FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS
DELAY IN PUBLICATION DOES NOT CALL INTO QUESTION EITHER THE FINANCIAL FIGURES ALREADY PUBLISHED ON SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 OR THE GROUP'S OPERATIONAL MOMENTUM
